title: My words
intro: All the words you are learning. Tap a word to see the details.
addHint: The word goes to the deck “{deck}”.
empty: No words yet. Add a word or a deck from the library.
dueNow: Already in the deck — waiting for review.
notStarted: Not studied yet — it will come up among new words.
backupText: Everything is stored in this browser only. Download a JSON file with your current progress and settings — you can restore from it at any time.
deleteText: The word will disappear from all your decks and will no longer come up for review.
myDecksTip: Your sets of words: browse, edit and review each one on its own.
